title: nepeta podostachys subsp. paulsenii
intro: Nepeta podostachys subsp. paulsenii, commonly known as Paulsen's catmint, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the mint family, Lamiaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include relieving anxiety and insomnia due to its calming effects, and its potential in managing symptoms of irritable bowel syndrome and nausea. The therapeutic actions of Nepeta podostachys subsp. paulsenii include acting as a nervine, sedative, and carminative, helping to soothe the nervous system, promote relaxation, and alleviate digestive discomfort. The bioactive constituents of this plant include neptine, nepetalactone, and ursolic acid, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and contribute to its therapeutic actions.
